acceptance: Extend the supplementary fail-closed trace envelope with bounded task revision, attempt, role, session label/reference, call and relationship identifiers, phase, outcome, duration, and wall-clock observations.
Represent source-labelled usage/cost observations and explicit unavailable states without capturing prompts, responses, tools, paths, secrets, or arbitrary exception text.
Preserve task-record authority, append-only local JSONL behavior, opaque session-ID-only external projection, and telemetry failure isolation.
Add provider-free fixtures covering delegated execution flow, retries, outcome classes, unavailable measurements, malformed telemetry, and privacy boundaries.
